hypothesis: M181 exhausts the M178 outcome rows: threshold changes cannot produce source-diverse accepted wrong-history rows. The next step must remine or rebuild the matched-current proof surface with physical-pair diversity as a first-class objective.
success_criteria: start from deployable P0 human-view inputs and keep actor inputs unchanged
mine candidate same-current different-history pairs with explicit physical-pair and left-step diversity
cap candidate rows per strict physical pair before boundary relocation
cover at least 10 strict physical pairs, 5 left steps, 2 target types, and 2 normal-margin buckets after robustness
run wrong-history-only boundary relocation before multi-variant replay
do not run PPO or actor updates until robustness passes
failure_criteria: reuse only the M178 accepted rows after M181 showed they are exhausted
rank solely by action distance or margin gap while ignoring pair diversity
use hidden/oracle quantities as actor inputs
promote duplicate-dominated rows into a training corpus

commands.name: m182_design_or_implement_source_diverse_miner
commands.command: Implement or configure a source-pair-diverse matched-current miner that selects candidates by strict physical pair, left step, target, normal-margin bucket, and obstacle bucket before relocation.

commands.name: m182_wrong_history_boundary_relocation
commands.command: Run wrong-history-only boundary relocation on the new source-diverse candidate set with M168 and M170 once the miner output is available.

commands.name: m182_robustness_gate
commands.command: Run boundary_wrong_history_surface_robustness with min accepted rows 40, min physical pairs 10, min left steps 5, min checkpoints 2, min targets 2, min margin buckets 2, and max rows per pair fraction 0.25.

decision_rule: Only a robustness-passing source-diverse surface can enter multi-variant replay or corpus construction; otherwise design active-probe data generation.
